evidence.why: Maps the ordinary battle, Sudden Death and Results states.
Performs guarded accounting and selects destinations according to the predicate.
Defines no-contest suppression and team/player winner-count testing.

facts.rationale: The wrapper supplies destination IDs 4 and 3, the table identifies their scenes, and the shared predicate preserves the no-contest exception omitted by the previous resolved-match description.
facts.value: Implements ordinary Slo-Mo Melee's post-battle handoff by delegating accounting and selecting Results at local state 4 when gm_MatchHasMultipleWinners is false, or Sudden Death at local state 3 when true. No-contest outcomes force the predicate false; otherwise it tests whether the applicable team or player winner count exceeds one. Zero-winner matches therefore also take the Results route.
